description: This file defines controller functions for managing assistants in a server-side application, including creating, deleting, retrieving, updating assistants, and fetching related data like chat models, document stores, and tools.

methods.name: createAssistant
methods.description: Handles creation of a new assistant, including validation, quota check, and invoking the assistant service.

methods.name: deleteAssistant
methods.description: Deletes an existing assistant by ID, validating parameters and workspace context.

methods.name: getAllAssistants
methods.description: Retrieves all assistants for a given workspace and optional type.

methods.name: getAssistantById
methods.description: Fetches a specific assistant by ID within a workspace.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an existing assistant identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getDocumentStores
methods.description: Fetches document stores associated with a workspace.

methods.name: generateAssistantInstruction
methods.description: Generates instructions for an assistant based on provided task and chat model.
